---
title: inif.viewer
description: HTML viewer implementations powering InifDocument.render_html / .save_html / .show.
reference: inif.viewer
---

The viewer is exposed as three methods on
[`InifDocument`](inif.models.qmd) — `render_html()`, `save_html(path)`,
and `show()`. The implementations live in this module.

See [HTML viewer](../workflows/viewer.qmd) for what the rendered page looks
like and the available options.
